label: Warm-ups

slides.title: Jog, stretch, go.
slides.body: A generic warm-up preps you for nothing in particular.

slides.title: Rehearse today's movements.
slides.body: Squats on the board? Squat in the warm-up. Light and smooth.

slides.title: Build to your working weight.
slides.body: Three or four sets, fewer reps each, same bar path every time.

slides.title: Taste the pace once.
slides.body: Thirty seconds at workout pace. Then rest before 3, 2, 1.
